name: Bus
description: A vehicle in the Northwind fleet, identified by its fleet number.

name: Garage
description: A depot that maintains buses and holds parts stock.

name: WorkOrder
description: An authorised job to repair or service one bus at one garage.

name: IncidentReport
description: The written review of an incident involving a bus.

name: PMLevel
description: A preventive maintenance level (PM-A, PM-B, PM-C) with its distance interval.

name: Part
description: A stocked spare part, identified by its part number.

name: StockLevel
description: How many units of one part one garage holds, and when to reorder.

name: Role
description: A position with responsibilities under the maintenance policy.

name: based_at
description: The garage a bus is assigned to.

name: for_bus
description: The bus a work order is about.

name: raised_at
description: The garage where the work order is carried out.

name: raised_from
description: The incident report a work order was opened in response to.

name: uses_part
description: A part consumed by the work order.

name: about_bus
description: The bus an incident report concerns.

name: reviewed_by
description: The role that must review the incident report.

name: performed_at
description: A garage allowed to perform this PM level.

name: approved_by
description: The role that approves changes to this PM level.

name: of_part
description: The part a stock level counts.

name: held_at
description: The garage holding the stock.

name: fleet_number
description: The number painted on the bus.

name: number
description: The work order number, e.g. WO-2291.

name: state
description: Whether the work order is still being worked.

name: opened_on
description: When the work order was opened.

name: occurred_on
description: When the incident happened.

name: interval_km
description: Distance between two services at this level.

name: part_number
description: The catalogue number, e.g. BRK-221.

name: on_hand
description: Units in stock when counted.

name: reorder_at
description: Stock level at or below which the garage reorders.
